generate_campaign_report.description: Generate comprehensive campaign performance report with JOINs and aggregations
generate_campaign_report.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        c.campaign_id,
                        c.campaign_name,
                        c.status,
                        c.channel,
                        c.budget,
                        c.start_date,
                        c.end_date,
                        COUNT(r.report_id) as total_reports,
                        SUM(r.impressions) as total_impressions,
                        SUM(r.clicks) as total_clicks,
                        SUM(r.conversions) as total_conversions,
                        SUM(r.cost) as total_cost,
                        ROUND(AVG(r.CTR), 4) as avg_ctr,
                        ROUND(AVG(r.CVR), 4) as avg_cvr,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.conversions), 0), 2) as cost_per_conversion,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.conversions) / NULLIF(SUM(r.clicks), 0) * 100, 2) as conversion_rate
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.status, c.channel, c.budget, c.start_date, c.end_date
                    ORDER BY total_conversions DESC

generate_channel_performance.description: Generate performance breakdown by marketing channel
generate_channel_performance.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        c.channel,
                        COUNT(DISTINCT c.campaign_id) as total_campaigns,
                        SUM(r.impressions) as total_impressions,
                        SUM(r.clicks) as total_clicks,
                        SUM(r.conversions) as total_conversions,
                        SUM(r.cost) as total_cost,
                        ROUND(AVG(r.CTR), 4) as avg_ctr,
                        ROUND(AVG(r.CVR), 4) as avg_cvr,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.conversions), 0), 2) as cost_per_conversion
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY c.channel
                    ORDER BY total_conversions DESC

generate_budget_analysis.description: Generate budget analysis and spending insights
generate_budget_analysis.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        c.campaign_id,
                        c.campaign_name,
                        c.budget,
                        SUM(r.cost) as actual_spend,
                        ROUND((SUM(r.cost) / c.budget) * 100, 2) as budget_utilization_pct,
                        c.budget - SUM(r.cost) as remaining_budget,
                        SUM(r.conversions) as total_conversions,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.conversions), 0), 2) as cost_per_conversion
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.budget
                    ORDER BY budget_utilization_pct DESC

generate_conversion_metrics.description: Generate detailed conversion metrics and KPIs
generate_conversion_metrics.sql_template:
SELECT 
                        c.campaign_id,
                        c.campaign_name,
                        c.channel,
                        SUM(r.impressions) as total_impressions,
                        SUM(r.clicks) as total_clicks,
                        SUM(r.conversions) as total_conversions,
                        SUM(r.cost) as total_cost,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(r.impressions), 0) * 100, 2) as ctr,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.conversions) / NULLIF(SUM(r.clicks), 0) * 100, 2) as cvr,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.clicks), 0), 2) as cpc,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.cost) / NULLIF(SUM(r.conversions), 0), 2) as cpa,
                        ROUND(SUM(r.conversions) / NULLIF(SUM(r.impressions), 0) * 100, 2) as conversion_rate
                    FROM main.default.campaigns c
                    LEFT JOIN main.default.reports r ON c.campaign_id = r.campaign_id
                    WHERE 1=1
                    {filters}
                    GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.channel
                    ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC
